# Metosphere

> > Metosphere provides cross-platform collection and inventory management apps for tracking personal collections of media, beverages, and entertainment across Android and iOS devices.

Metosphere offers a suite of mobile applications designed to help users catalog, rate, and manage their personal collections. Each app features barcode scanning, ratings systems, and social sharing capabilities, with both free and premium versions available on Android and iOS platforms.

## Key Topics

- Android apps
- iOS apps
- Inventory tracking
- Barcode scanning
- Collection management
- Rating systems
- Media organization
- Social sharing
- Personal inventory
- Google Play
- Mobile apps
- Collection apps
- Tracking apps

## Collection & Inventory Apps

- [Wine App](https://dystopian.com/wine): Wine List, Ratings & Cellar Pro/Free - Android app for wine tracking, ratings, and cellar management.
- [Android Movie Collection App](https://dystopian.com/movie): Movie Collection & Inventory Pro - Android app for DVD/Blu-ray tracking with barcode scanning.
- [Android Book App](https://dystopian.com/book): Book Collection & Inventory Pro/Free - Android app for book management with barcode scanner.
- [Android Game App](https://dystopian.com/game): Game Collection & Inventory Pro/Free - Android app for game collection tracking and ratings.
- [Android Music Collection App](https://dystopian.com/music): Music Collection & Inventory Pro/Free - Android app for music catalog and physical media tracking.

## Beverage & Social Tracking

- [Beer App](https://dystopian.com/beer): Beer tracking app for iPhone/Android with tasting notes and community features.

## Optional

- [Casino App](https://dystopian.com/casino): Casino app for iPhone with poker/slots gambling tracker and session analytics.
